evidence: X-ray diﬀraction (XRD) measurements were used to evaluate the ﬁlm crystallinity Xc at various stages of crystallization. Rutherford backscattering (RBS) and elastic recoil detection (ERD) were used to obtain absolute atomic densities of most notably indium, oxygen, and hydrogen. The oxygen and indium binding conﬁgurations were assessed from X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS). The ﬁlm optoelectronic properties were evaluated from Hall measurements in the Van der Pauw conﬁguration and by spectroscopic ellipsometry (SE). In addition, cross-sectional TEM images of a fully crystallized sample are shown.
